summary: NAT-112 analysis: fb_diff=0 in NAT-111 is a measurement artifact. The 5-second statistics window never closed (only 2 swaps in 0.53s). drawLayer() was called with valid 1125x2436 BGRA surfaces. MiniIOSurfaceDrawn() returns true for CPU-rendered surfaces (fence==0). The commit path works correctly. No kernel patch needed. Stopped-executor takeover procedure documented in docs/agent-workflow.md.

findings.fb_diff_mechanism: Statistics printed only when nanos >= 5*NSEC_PER_SEC inside show(); NAT-111 had 2 swaps in 0.53s, window never closed
findings.MiniIOSurfaceDrawn_behavior: Returns true when surface->drawn==0 (no GPU fence, CPU-rendered)
findings.next_experiment: rec_secs=30 rec_start=30 rec_mb=64 rec_ring=1 with loader_return_after=120 to capture actual frames
